prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium social campaign poster, landscape 16:9, preferably 2048x1152. This is for 0xWallet, the browser extension of the 0xNothing crypto project, not Nothing consumer electronics. Input image 1 is the exact brand identity reference: white angular N with one small RED circular dot at bottom-right on black. Preserve that N-and-red-dot mark precisely, never add a green dot. Input image 2 is the authentic UI reference: use ONLY the wallet interface on its right, ignore its existing left-side marketing layout. Make a new art-directed composition, not a collage or guideline board.
Scene: near-black (#050806) tactile studio background with a very subtle mint-green (#8ee9b8) edge light, warm white text (#edf5f0), restrained technical-editorial feel. No purple, cheap neon, coin rain or price-growth charts. Left half is spacious typographic hierarchy, right half a beautifully detailed desktop browser frame with the wallet popup anchored to its top-right toolbar; large legible wallet, almost front facing, authentic square hairline UI and monochrome pixel/mono labels, same real screen structure as reference. Browser content behind the popup should be quiet dark empty geometry, no other products or invented dashboards. The reference balance and tokens are demonstrative; include the exact small label "DEMO DATA" near the screen. No seed words, passwords, fictional returns or security certification badges.
Visible text verbatim, no extra slogan:
small top-left: "0xWallet" beside the authentic N-red-dot mark
small label: "BROWSER EXTENSION"
large dominant headline over two lines: "Your keys." / "Your move."
supporting one-line: "Built for LitVM testnet."
bottom line: "SEND / RECEIVE / SWAP"
small footer: "0xNothing"
Use very large beautifully spaced warm-white sans-serif headline, mint for one quiet accent, crisp monospace secondary labels. Content must remain inside generous safe margins. Only one screen and one identity mark, not multiple competing cards. Polished launch photography / CGI and precise typography.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium 4:5 portrait social poster, preferably 1536x1920. Brand 0xWallet by 0xNothing, a self-custody EVM wallet with an Android build for LitVM testnet. This is an APP PREVIEW, do not claim a public store release. Input image 1 is the exact identity reference: geometric white N with small RED circular dot at its bottom-right. Preserve that mark and its white/red colors, not the Nothing electronics logotype. Input image 2 provides the authentic wallet interface on its right: use its real design language, exact token labels zkLTC and NUSD and square mint-accent controls. Ignore the left marketing side of input 2.
Art direction: a single refined matte-black Android phone, nearly front-facing with a barely tilted perspective, hovering against rich near-black #050806 studio darkness with a restrained mint #8ee9b8 side light. The phone is the substantial visual anchor centered in the lower two thirds. It shows the same wallet structure from the reference, with clear balance area, SEND / RECEIVE / HISTORY, token list and HOME / SWAP / DAPP navigation. Crisp and plausible, no shiny generic fintech interface, no fake profitable chart, no seed phrases, no random icons. Small "DEMO DATA" label by the phone.
At top, warm white #edf5f0 editorial typography with clear hierarchy. Visible campaign text verbatim:
"0xWallet" with the authentic N-and-red-dot brand mark
"Your wallet."
"In your hands."
small accent label "ANDROID APP PREVIEW"
footer "LitVM testnet / Self-custody"
and small "0xNothing".
No App Store or Google Play badges, no download-now claim, no QR code. Excellent whitespace, readable large typography, professional material and light rendering, cohesive with a dark-mint browser-extension campaign.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished landscape 16:9 premium social campaign poster, preferably 2048x1152, introducing 0xWallet on browser and Android. Input image 1 is the exact 0xNothing identity, a WHITE geometric N and a small RED dot at bottom-right on black. Keep this precise identity. Input image 2 is authentic UI reference: the wallet panel at its right is the only UI reference, ignore its surrounding old marketing design.
Composition: one quiet wide cinematic stage on near-black #050806. Top-left clean large headline and small brand mark, lower-right a single browser-extension wallet window and one Android phone arranged with disciplined shallow perspective, parallel verticals, no clutter or redundant cards. Make both interfaces dark, mint #8ee9b8, crisp square fine borders and monospace/pixel labels like the reference. Use restrained soft rim lighting and realistic screen glass, no glow clouds or neon cyberpunk, no products from the wider ecosystem, no extra logos. Use only 0xWallet and 0xNothing branding. Demo wallet balances may match the supplied public demo screenshot; clearly add "DEMO DATA" under the screen group.
Exact campaign copy:
small brand "0xWallet"
large headline: "One wallet." then "Two ways in."
secondary: "Browser extension / Android app preview"
short footer: "Your keys stay with you."
small status: "LITVM TESTNET"
small brand footer: "0xNothing"
No store availability badges, no mainnet claim, no guaranteed security or returns. In the UI keep labels legible and sparse. The poster should feel like one cohesive premium product launch image, not an overview grid or crowded presentation.
